notes.title: DLCs “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin” and “Jukebox” are now available! 🕹️
notes.content:
[h3][b]PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC Paid DLC “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin” and “Jukebox” are now available! Free updates to improve background music quality and stability are also available![/b][/h3]

Now for PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC, the highly rated action-adventure game from Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.,[b] two new paid DLC[/b] as well as a [b]free update[/b] of the game are[b] both now available for download[/b].

[previewyoutube=N13TPCH2y6E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Paid DLC “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin”[/b][/h2]
[h3]PAC-MAN with a [b]black Chogokin robot design[/b]! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/20870b5c3ee7ce7edd00d00cc90a45782284bdaa.png[/img]

[h3]The appearance of Metal PAC-MAN in "Quest Mode" can be changed to “Chogokin PAC-MAN” in the game Options.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/c85589b574a6f04e03e0d5adab1e612202be1008.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/e16f17039c511fbfef2db832f947da098d951a9f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/eba85bbc3752ceea9ffd1292fc5fa84219b32271.png[/img]

[h2][b]Paid DLC "Jukebox"[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/6fc56af67ef4cc785044c68815cfa4a8ddcc5276.png[/img]

[h3]A jukebox [b]will appear on the beach at Ghost Island[/b]. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/4add4fbf03e2182882aa6fda9a149662ac2ba03e.png[/img]
[h3]At the jukebox, you can [b]change the background music played[/b] on Ghost Island by selecting from [b]more than 50 songs[/b] in the game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/b5ce0e9c60df5da2fed0ecff033fec5d40b0bce9.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859470/PACMAN_WORLD_RePAC

notes.title: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-Pac is now available! 🕹️
notes.content:
[h2][b]PAC-MAN is back![/b][/h2]
PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC, the remake of PAC-MAN’s first foray into 3D platforming is available today!

[previewyoutube=JLhu5ggOKWI;full][/previewyoutube] 

PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC brings back a [b]wonderfully original world of adventure[/b] for PAC-MAN, where our hero is now chasing the Ghosts [b]to rescue PAC-MOM, PAC-BOY, PAC-SIS, Professor PAC, PAC-BUDDY, and Pooka[/b] from their clutches only to discover a new nemesis in the [b]dreaded TOC-MAN[/b].

[b]Rescue the PAC-FAM from Ghost Island[/b] in this remastered classic 3D platformer and guide PAC-MAN through a [b]world full of adventures[/b]!

[h3][b]Now available![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859470/PACMAN_WORLD_RePAC/
